article.story: UMass (5-4) at Toledo (7-2), Nov. 11 at 7:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Toledo by 14. Against the spread: Toledo 4-4-1, UMass 4-5. How to watch: CBS Sports Network Key stats Toledo Offense Overall: 455.3 yards per game (17th in FBS) Passing: 262.8 yards per game (29th) Rushing: 192.6 yards per game (28th) Scoring: 35.4 points per game (22nd) Toledo Defense Overall: 314.3 yards per game (26th in FBS) Passing: 199.9 yards per game (51st) Rushing: 114.4 yards per game (30th) Scoring: 24.4 points per game (67th) UMass Offense Overall: 348.0 yards per game (106th in FBS) Passing: 200.6 yards per game (99th) Rushing: 147.4 yards per game (78th) Scoring: 27.0 points per game (76th) UMass Defense Overall: 327.0 yards per game (37th in FBS) Passing: 181.9 yards per game (20th) Rushing: 145.1 yards per game (74th) Scoring: 22.1 points per game (49th) UMass is 122nd in third down percentage, converting 32.7% of the time. Toledo ranks 34th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 34.1%. UMass ranks 23rd in the FBS with a +5 turnover margin. Toledo ranks 119th in the FBS with 69.7 penalty yards per game. UMass ranks 115th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 90.3% of trips. Toledo's red zone offense ranks 6th, scoring on 94.6% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders Toledo Passing: John Alan Richter, 2,304 yards, 18 TDs, 3 INTs, 65.9 completion percentage Rushing: C.J. Miller, 744 yards on 136 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Adjatay Dabbs, 592 yards on 40 catches, 7 TDs UMass Passing: William Watson III, 1,327 yards, 9 TDs, 2 INTs, 69.3 completion percentage Rushing: Elijah Faulkner, 400 yards on 99 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: T.Y. Harding, 397 yards on 34 catches, 2 TDs Last game Toledo won 20-17 over Sacramento State on Nov. 4. Richter led Toledo with 60 yards on 9-of-17 passing (52.9%) for one touchdown and one interception. Miller had 135 rushing yards on 27 carries. Anthony Simpson had one reception for 18 yards and one touchdown. UMass beat Ball State 31-30 on Nov. 4. Watson led UMass with 302 yards on 17-of-25 passing (68.0%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball eight times for 40 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Curtis Kimmons IV had 85 rushing yards on 19 carries, adding one reception for 10 yards. Kezion Dia-Johnson recorded 97 yards on three catches. Next game Toledo hosts Bowling Green on Nov. 20. UMass hosts Akron on Nov. 18.
